model.note.fsr4fast: AMD neural network · twice as fast
model.note.off: Without Vela · as Steam runs it
model.why.chip_no_fsr4: FSR 4 needs the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 or newer NPU; use FSR 3 or SGSR 2
steam_fsr1: Steam's own FSR 1 is there: Quick Access → Performance → Scaling Filter. It works when the game's resolution is below 1080p
t.noGame: Open a game's page in the library or start a game. Vela is switched on for each game separately.
t.pickHint: Pick a model — Vela sets up the rest.
speed.fsr4: Speed — the DLSS / FSR mode in the game's settings
speed.sgsr2: DirectX 11: only SGSR 2 works here. Speed — the DLSS / FSR mode in the game
speed.static: Speed — the FSR 2 mode in the game's settings
reason.anticheat: the game uses anti-cheat, which blocks Vela's files
reason.opengl: the game uses OpenGL; DirectX 11 or 12 is needed
reason.vulkan_native: the game uses Vulkan; DirectX 11 or 12 is needed
reason.no_inputs: the game has no DLSS, FSR or XeSS — nothing to replace
reason.no_exe: a Linux game; a Windows game is needed
reason.godot: a Godot game: its FSR 2 is built into the engine, Vela cannot replace it
menu.xess: choose XeSS (or FSR, if there is one)
menu.any: choose DLSS or FSR — whichever the menu has
hint.restart_window: Restart the game — the window becomes 1920×1080
hint.dx12_choice: At launch, choose the DX12 option
hint.npu_missing_layer: This Vela build has no NPU layer
hint.npu_install: For FSR 4 on the NPU install «Vela NPU» (once, needs your sudo password): Desktop mode → Konsole → {cmd}
hint.npu_update_up: For 3× smaller render update «Vela NPU» (package 12): Desktop mode → Konsole → {cmd}
hint.npu_qnn: «Vela NPU» is installed incompletely (no Qualcomm QNN libraries): run the installer again (needs your sudo password): {cmd}
hint.npu_service: The NPU service is not running — restart the console
hint.npu_failed: The NPU service failed — restart the console. If that does not help, install «Vela NPU» again: {cmd}
hint.game_res: The game outputs {got} — set {res} in its settings
hint.chip_v79: Snapdragon 8 Elite: FSR 4 on the GPU only (no NPU graphs for v79), FSR 4 Fast is not available
hint.chip_other: Chip {chip}: FSR 4 needs the Snapdragon 8 Gen 2 or newer NPU; use FSR 3 or SGSR 2
st.onIdleSub: takes effect when the game starts
st.nextStart: Turns on at the next game start
st.waitingSub: Normal in the game's menu. If the game is already running — {what}
st.waitingFsr2: turn on FSR 2 in the graphics settings
st.notOffered: The model «{key}» is gone — {runs} runs. Pick a model
st.fsr3FailedSub: no amd_fidelityfx_dx12.dll in the game folder, or FFX refused
st.layer: The Vela Any layer was removed from Vela
st.layerRunning: close the game — Vela turns the layer off
npu_reason.nolayer: the Vela NPU layer is not in the game — restart the game
npu_reason.nodaemon: the Vela NPU service does not answer
npu_reason.size: the NPU cannot do this frame size
npu_reason.timeout: the NPU did not answer in time
rp.title: Report to the developers
rp.files: The report has {n} files, {kb} KB (names, paths, Steam IDs, IPs removed):
rp.sent: Report sent: {id}. Quote this number when you write to us.
rp.notConfigured: Sending reports is not set up yet. The report is saved: {path}
rp.rateLimited: At most 3 reports an hour — try again in {min} min. The report is saved.
rp.failed: Not sent ({why}). The report is saved — you can send it again.
rp.askTitle: The game closed with a problem
rp.ask: Send a report to the developers?
rp.toast: The game closed with a problem. Open Vela to send a report.
rp.why.short_run: the game closed in the first minutes
up.confirm: Confirm the update in Decky's window. Vela reloads after it.
up.title: Updates
up.autoDesc: Once a day Vela asks GitHub for the newest version number; only that is fetched, nothing about you is sent.
up.err.github: GitHub did not answer (error {code}); try again later
up.err.bad_answer: GitHub sent an answer Vela could not read
up.err.no_zip: The new release has no Vela zip yet
up.err.no_checksum: The new release has no checksum file, so Vela will not install it
up.err.hash_mismatch: The download does not match its checksum; nothing was installed
up.err.bad_zip: The download is not a Vela plugin; nothing was installed
up.err.no_decky: Decky could not start the install
hint.dx11_run: The game ran in DirectX 11. Vela works in DirectX 12: switch the game to DX12 in its graphics settings (or add -dx12 to its Steam launch options), then restart it
hint.out_format: FSR 4 cannot write this game's image format: pick FSR 3 or SGSR 2
st.dx11: The game ran in DirectX 11 — Vela needs DirectX 12
